facts.fact: Hair is long enough to fall down and be swept upward

Sclera dyed blood-red during power surge

facts.fact: Eyes crescent-shaped (curved like half-moons) when smiling
Face is fierce and grim-looking (contorted into a menacing expression)

excluded.reason: Eyes flaring red is a temporary power-surge effect, not his base look
Blood-red sclera appears only during a power surge, so it is a temporary change
Crescent-shaped eyes are a smiling expression, not a fixed trait
A menacing contorted face is a momentary expression, not a fixed trait
Narrowed eyes are a momentary expression. The 'narrow-set' reading is a mistranslation, since the quote says the eyes narrowed

line: - **Appearance (as of ch 263):** The Blood Lord appears to be a young man. His hair is long enough to fall loose and be swept upward. Tags: young man, loose hair, swept-back hair
